title: Arkret History Key Recovery
description: Canonical private request delivery, capability-addressed response stream, proof and packed-range wire for exporter-scheme history recovery.

history_candidate_material_key.description: Global received-material identity. Origin is deliberately absent; equal bytes at the same scope/group/epoch deduplicate to one resident material instance.

history_candidate_material_record.description: Device-local resident received bytes. material_received_sequence is assigned once when this byte instance becomes resident and is immutable; adding origin attribution never refreshes it. Eviction removes this record but not bounded attribution tombstones, and refetch creates a new record with a new sequence. local_authoritative uses a separate record class.

origin_quota_domain.description: Stable quota identity. It equals the verified response source_sender_domain and does not change across response ids or retries.
Stable holder/key/effective-rotation quota tuple. accepted_key_evidence_ref is the rotation identity; archive/container retrieval coordinates are deliberately excluded.
Stable backup series/producer quota identity. Individual backup envelopes are retrieval coordinates only.

backup_origin_id.description: Use backup:<BackupId> when the envelope carries a canonical BackupId; otherwise backup:sha256:<hex of exact envelope bytes>. This is an origin identifier, never sender_domain.

history_candidate_origin_attribution.description: Independent origin ledger row keyed by (material_key,origin_domain,origin_ref), with a separate stable origin_quota_domain. origin_ref is only a retrieval coordinate and never selects quota identity. The fixed expiry is computed as immutable first_observed_at+2592000 seconds and is not stored. It never duplicates secret bytes or refreshes material_received_sequence.

event_candidate_binding.description: Independent Event binding keyed by (event_binding_key,candidate_digest,outcome). It contains no origin and must not be used to infer one or pin candidate bytes. The fixed expiry is computed as first_observed_at+2592000 seconds and is not stored.

requester_endpoint_authorization.description: Requester-signed exact endpoint authorization locator. The release service re-resolves this same current PCR device or Agent authorization at create and every first chunk enqueue; it never substitutes the current session endpoint. Minimal-metadata uses only its Realm-local pairwise endpoint actor and therefore carries no principal/device locator.

method_controller_principal_id.description: Principal projection of the holder signing authority named by holder_signing_ref. This is intentionally not an AccountId: the tuple separately binds the service route/authority in holder_service_id.

holder_service_id.description: History-key holder service route and authority. It has a different role from method_controller_principal_id (the signing principal projection) and MUST NOT be inferred from or compared as though it were that principal.

holder_trusted_basis.description: Holder-durable canonical accepted Seal basis with exactly one confirmed head per Realm supplied in the accepted register/rotate holder-acceptance proof. The accepted_key_evidence_ref Event and its effective registered tuple are verified by replay from this basis; no singular activation Seal is carried.

realm_current_gate_projection.description: Closed Realm current-gate projection. source_authorization_incarnation is required by the registered member-source branch and forbidden by the organization-recovery-holder branch.

circle_current_gate_projection.description: Closed Circle current-gate projection. Each authorization incarnation is the closed Realm+Circle form and therefore binds the parent-Realm intersection. source_authorization_incarnation follows the same member/holder branch rule as Realm.

seal_view_locator.description: Exact confirmed safety basis. Every referenced Realm contributes one confirmed head; competing heads from the same Realm are not a valid basis. A cached basis is routing/evidence context, never an independent membership or key-release authorization. Safety commands still validate the exact actual predecessor and registered current gate.

account_status_view_locator.description: Account Authority issuer-ledger record locator/digest; never a Realm/CBS proof.

pcr_seal_basis.description: Exact confirmed safety basis. Every referenced Realm contributes one confirmed head; competing heads from the same Realm are not a valid basis. A cached basis is routing/evidence context, never an independent membership or key-release authorization. Safety commands still validate the exact actual predecessor and registered current gate.

device_generation_ref.description: PCR-local monotonic device generation; it is not an EventId or DID versionId.

source_relay_view_locator.description: Digest locator for the complete SourceRelayAttestation verified by the requester release service. Source account/device/Agent or holder authority coordinates remain solely inside the source local Station's signed relay attestation.

accepted_authority_view_vector.description: Closed typed locator/digest vector in an honest release-service decision receipt. It carries no portable multi-authority proof. Profiles and source kind occur only in the outer attestation.

epoch_range.description: Inclusive non-empty range; from_epoch <= to_epoch is mandatory semantic validation.

history_secret_range.description: Packed history_secret[from] || ... || history_secret[to]. The receiver resolves KDF.Nh from each exact winning transition reconstructed by the receipt-bound certified exact safety-fact verification under cbs-profiles section 9 (full replay only for executing/voting replicas and replay auditors) and requires decoded length=(to-from+1)*KDF.Nh.

secret_range.description: Its inclusive range must equal the outer chunk covered_epoch_range byte-for-byte. Decoded packed length is the sum of exact per-epoch KDF.Nh values resolved from the corresponding activation transitions.

history_chunk_plaintext.description: The only HPKE plaintext for a history response chunk. Every opened secret globally deduplicates by HistoryCandidateMaterialKey, never origin, and gets a separate response_sender CandidateOriginAttribution; it never becomes local_authoritative. Success/failure EventCandidateBinding contains no origin and does not pin bytes. It contains history secrets only and cannot carry active MLS state, sender counters, snapshots, policy claims or source metadata.

response_capability_b64u.description: Canonical unpadded base64url of exactly 32 service-generated CSPRNG bytes.

history_response_capability_plaintext.description: The only plaintext admitted by SealedHistoryResponseCapability. HPKE seals the RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8 bytes of this closed object; raw bytes, a bare base64url string and nested JSON text are forbidden.

history_secret_b64u.description: Unpadded base64url of the exact history_secret for archive.epoch. Its decoded length must equal KDF.Nh of the winning group transition proven for that epoch.

organization_recovery_archive_plaintext.description: The only RHRK archive HPKE plaintext. An opened secret globally deduplicates by HistoryCandidateMaterialKey and gets a separate rhrk_archive CandidateOriginAttribution; it never becomes local_authoritative. Success/failure EventCandidateBinding contains no origin and does not pin bytes. HPKE seals RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8 of this object. It cannot carry active MLS state, counters, policy snapshots, holder claims or another epoch.

requester_authorization_incarnation.description: Exact closed current membership-incarnation set for this scope. Create admission verifies it and retry preserves it byte-for-byte.

requested_ranges.description: Canonical requested range set. Before signing, sort by (from_epoch,to_epoch), remove duplicates, and merge every overlapping or adjacent pair. A verifier rejects an array that is not strictly increasing, pairwise disjoint, and pairwise non-adjacent in that canonical form.

expires_at.description: Canonical request expiry. Accepted create admission requires byte-for-byte equality with receipt.expires_at, response-stream expiry and history_traversal_retention.traversal_intent.retention.expires_at.

history_key_request.description: Signed requester intent: exact scope, actor, incarnation, endpoint, ranges, recipient key and expiry. The Account Station selects and verifies the retained governance cut; no client checkpoint fields.

release_id.description: The requester's authenticated current Station selected as the unique honest release service for this request response stream.

release_service_resolution_ref.description: Adapter-canonical service resolution reference; it is not an Arkret EventId.

release_service_resolution_digest.description: SHA-256 of the complete canonical AuthenticatedServiceResolution retained at request acceptance.

release_service_route_digest.description: SHA-256(RFC8785-JCS(ServiceResolutionProjection)) derived from the authenticated DID method state.

history_traversal_retention.description: Member branch only. Intent request_digest, effective_scope, derived mls_group_id, authorization_incarnation, requested_ranges and expiry bind the accepted request. Base/current/target are release-service selected and verified retained traversal coordinates, not requester pins.

expires_at.description: Byte-for-byte equal to request.expires_at, response-stream expiry and history_traversal_retention.traversal_intent.retention.expires_at.

history_governance_traversal_intent.description: Frozen receipt-bound verification coordinates and exact ranges. Non-voting consumers authenticate every required epoch/transition, suite, incarnation, policy and base/current/target ancestry using cbs-profiles section 9. Executing/voting replicas and replay auditors retain complete direct traversal. No client checkpoint or global latest assertion.

history_governance_traversal_retention.description: Role-specific retention for the frozen intent. Non-voting consumers durably pin authenticated configurations, quorum conclusions, exact epoch/transition bytes and necessary source dependencies before signing the receipt; full replay roles pin the complete cut, all command results and registered dependencies. Member retention ends at request expiry; RHRK retention equals archive lifetime. No proof package, new profile or client checkpoint. A reader role does not remove independent audit, voting, archive durability or GC obligations.

self_history_traversal_access.description: Narrow self resolve authorization for the exact retained direct-traversal cut. The service derives the cut and allowed Control Move/apply_seal dependency set from the named durable receipt or accepted archive replica; callers cannot enumerate an allowed descriptor set.

peer_history_traversal_access.description: Authenticated peer resolve authorization only for a pending organization-recovery archive replica. Member request replicas distribute request bytes but never authorize or promise a governance closure; the release service obtains and pins that cut through ordinary Realm governance sync before signing the request receipt. Unknown, unauthorized, outside-cut and missing selectors have one response shape.

sealed_history_response_capability.description: Uses the single active history-response-capability HPKE registry profile; algorithm fields are forbidden.

history_key_request_replica.description: Private S2S immutable request fanout from the release service to either the Station selected by one exact current member identity and membership Event, or an exact RHRK holder service whose archive tuple intersects requested ranges. destination_authorization is a closed union and must name destination_id.

rhrk_holder_authority_observation.description: Current source-local RHRK holder authority observation. archive_authorization_tuple_digest binds the immutable historical archive tuple; current_holder_signing_ref, accepted_key_evidence_ref and holder_trusted_basis prove current holder authority and are not required to equal the tuple's historical signing/evidence coordinates. Its registered digest is SHA-256(UTF8('ak.rhrk-holder-authority-observation-v1') || 0x00 || JCS(complete object)).

source_relay_attestation.description: The source's authenticated local Station verifies current source AccountId/device, hosted ActorId, exact membership Event or RHRK holder authority and signs this private relay receipt. The first accepted self send atomically stores the exact relay envelope/outbox keyed by (response_id,source_record_digest); relayed_at and proof are never regenerated on retry/restart, and the first accepted outcome is durably backfilled. Exact retry returns those byte-identical bytes without a duplicate status. For RHRK the source proof uses current_holder_signing_ref; historical archive holder_signing_ref is provenance only.

history_key_source_relay.description: Private S2S immutable source record carrier to request_receipt.release_id. The destination verifies the relay service against the source ActorId and current membership or RHRK authority before it performs the final T1 linearization and creates HistoryReleaseAttestation.

covered_epoch_range.description: The one inclusive continuous range covered by this exact chunk_response_id. Descriptor ranges are pairwise disjoint across descriptors; their canonical ordered union is the sole manifest and attempt coverage truth and must be a subset of the request's requested_ranges. No second manifest-level ranges array exists.

history_response_manifest.description: manifest_digest = H(UTF8('ak.history-response-manifest-v1') || 0x00 || JCS(the closed HistoryKeyResponseSigningInput whose content.kind is ak.history_key.response_manifest)). Descriptors are sorted by chunk_index and are the sole truth for response id and one continuous range. covered_epoch_range must be a canonical subset of the request ranges authorized by certified exact safety-fact verification; no proof/package selection is carried. A chunk repeats only manifest_digest and chunk_index. The canonical manifest source record is at most 256 KiB. Its first accepted send receipt, or the byte-identical receipt returned by an exact retry, must be durable before any named chunk is submitted.

authorized_ranges.description: Canonical sorted, disjoint exact descriptor ranges that passed the current scope history-access ratchet, requester current incarnation and join/profile floor after complete certified exact safety-fact verification under cbs-profiles section 9 (full replay only for executing/voting replicas and replay auditors). It must equal the complete manifest descriptor range union; partial admission is forbidden.

history_manifest_admission.description: Deterministic service-authenticated T0 result written atomically after authenticating every required epoch/transition, suite, incarnation, join floor, T0 ceiling, current ratchet and frozen base/current/target ancestry under cbs-profiles section 9. Non-voting admission does not replay unrelated control history. Missing middle epochs, wrong lineage/scope/incarnation or range mismatch rejects the entire manifest with zero admission writes. Execution/replay audit roles retain full apply_seal checks.

manifest_admission_digest.description: Must equal the already accepted manifest's deterministic HistoryManifestAdmission digest. Missing/mismatch is dependency_missing and writes no chunk record or attestation.

sealed_history_chunk.description: Minimal chunk wire. The exact accepted manifest descriptor and manifest_admission_digest reconstruct the continuous range and HPKE context. T0 is the receipt-bound certified exact safety-fact verification under cbs-profiles section 9 (full replay only for executing/voting replicas and replay auditors) recorded by the accepted manifest admission; the chunk carries no independent proof, selector, segment or range-key duplicate. Source submit before that manifest admission is accepted is dependency_missing with zero pending state, zero response record and zero release attestation. The complete canonical chunk source record MUST be at most 2 MiB.

source_signer_evidence_ref.description: Content-addressed source signer evidence. Its embedded digest is the sole wire copy (encoding.md 4.0.1) and resolves through the request-receipt governance-dependency surface to the exact historical source signer and verification method.

identity_link_signer_evidence_ref.description: Content-addressed Principal signer evidence for the IdentityLink proof verification_method at the link effective_at boundary.

minimal_metadata_mls_leaf_signer_evidenc.description: Content-addressed historical signer evidence for a minimal-metadata pairwise actor. The source proof always uses the independent Ed25519 response-signing method/key committed by the end-to-end encrypted IdentityLink; it never treats an MLS ciphersuite signature key as a generic PayloadProof key. The identity_link_signer_evidence pair resolves the exact Principal evidence used to verify the IdentityLink's own proof without consulting a live DID document. The receiver validates that proof, the response key, exact locally received identity-link and RFC MLS LeafNode canonical bytes, winning transition provenance, target Seal basis and authorization incarnation against its independently verified durable MLS state before accepting source_proof. Canonical evidence bytes are limited to 1 MiB.

history_key_response_send_request_body.description: The source wire carries request_digest and request_receipt_digest only, plus the content-addressed historical source signer-evidence locator required to verify source_proof. Source service resolves the exact already-verified local request replica/list record by those digests; destination release service resolves its own durable request/receipt, verifies and pins the exact signer evidence plus its transitive attester closure until request expiry, and exposes that closure through the request-receipt governance-dependency surface. Unknown or mismatched digest or evidence is dependency_missing with zero write. Repeating the full request receipt or signer evidence bytes in every manifest/chunk is forbidden.

manifest_admission_digest.description: Exact digest of the previously accepted all-or-nothing manifest T0 admission.

t0_pass.description: Copied from the accepted HistoryManifestAdmission; it is not a caller-supplied authorization boolean.

released_range.description: The exact continuous chunk range; byte-for-byte equal to the matching already admitted manifest descriptor. Its authorization is reconstructed from the receipt-bound direct Seal traversal and current monotone history-access state, not from a page or selection field.

expires_at.description: MUST be <= and normally byte-for-byte equal to request/response-stream expiry. The record is admitted only while unexpired; a receiver may install the immutable record after a later read if accepted_at was within this bound.

verifier_profile_id.description: Frozen verifier profile implemented locally and selected by this id.

history_release_attestation.description: Immutable honest-release-service T1 decision receipt from first durable chunk enqueue. The requester Station verifies its local recipient authority slots, the short-lived SourceRelayAttestation and relay-service binding, plus current scope membership. Source account/device/Agent or holder facts occur only in that source-local relay attestation and are not duplicated as remote views. The service validates every intent-bound observation is unexpired and has no known successor, then CAS-writes this locator vector and record in one local transaction. The vector is an audit coordinate, not a portable multi-authority proof.

record_digest.description: Must equal SHA-256(UTF8('ak.history-response-record-v1') || 0x00 || JCS({sequence,cursor,source_record,sent_at,release_service_signer_evidence_ref,manifest_admission?,release_attestation?})). A manifest has exactly manifest_admission; a chunk has exactly release_attestation. record_digest and service_proof are excluded.

release_attestation.description: Required only for a chunk. The service creates it in the same transaction as the first durable record enqueue after evaluating current T1 authority views. Exact retries return the original attestation.

manifest_admission.description: Required only for a manifest. The outer service proof authenticates the complete deterministic T0 admission.

release_service_signer_evidence_ref.description: Content-addressed Service-kind historical signer evidence used by this exact release-service proof. Its embedded digest is the sole wire copy (encoding.md 4.0.1).

service_proof.description: The honest release-service proof signs the RFC 8785 JCS transcript of the entire closed record with only service_proof omitted. For a chunk this coverage includes the byte-identical complete release_attestation and its typed authority locator/digest vector; the attestation has no independent proof wire.

history_key_response_record.description: The recipient response stream retains this complete byte-identical source record and conditional attestation only until a valid durable high-water disposition acknowledges it. Ack before durable install/reject/lost handling is a client error. The ack transaction atomically removes the large record/attestation and releases active quota; only the compact source-facing HistoryKeyResponseSendReceipt ledger remains through request expiry for exact source retry.

release_service_signer_evidence_ref.description: Content-addressed Service-kind historical signer evidence used by this exact lost-record proof. Its embedded digest is the sole wire copy (encoding.md 4.0.1).

service_proof.description: Release-service signature over the closed lost descriptor with service_proof omitted.

history_key_response_lost_record.description: Signed descriptor for an unrecoverably lost accepted response record. It permits only a durable service_record_lost disposition and never counts as manifest or epoch coverage.

history_response_page_entry.description: One item in the single sequence-ordered response stream. Pagination, limit, cursor, ack token and high-water all use this merged order; records and lost descriptors are never paginated separately.

entries.description: Strictly sequence-ascending merged record/lost entries. The verifier extracts each tuple {sequence,kind,response_id,entry_digest}, where entry_digest is record_digest or the digest of the complete signed lost descriptor.

source_signer_results.description: Exactly the distinct source_signer_evidence_ref values used by this page records, in strict UTF-8 ascending ref order. No duplicates, surplus, or missing entries. Empty for a page containing only lost descriptors or no entries.

cipher_suite.description: Registered MLS ciphersuite from the accepted Genesis of the exact receipt-bound scope/group. Required exactly when this page contains a record. The Station verifies continuous winning-lineage coverage of the admitted ranges; clients use the registered KDF.Nh and checked range lengths without fetching governance history.

history_key_response_list_outcome.description: Complete canonical page <=8 MiB, including deduplicated signer results, records, cursor and ACK token. The serving release Station is the Account Station frozen by the accepted request; these are trusted results, not client governance checkpoints.

history_response_ack_entry.description: Must match one byte-identical page entry at the same sequence. service_record_lost is structurally impossible for a normal record; all other dispositions are structurally impossible for a lost descriptor. installed on a manifest installs only its descriptor/admission, never epoch coverage.

ack_token.description: Authenticated token whose semantic preimage binds the internally resolved request_id, the exact contiguous sequence interval, high_water_cursor and ordered tuples {sequence,kind,response_id,record_digest|lost_record_digest}.

entries.description: Canonical strictly sequence-ascending entries matching the list page/ack token. Every sequence through high_water_cursor must have exactly one durable disposition.

manifest_admission_digest.description: Exact accepted manifest admission digest. For a manifest this is the admission created in the same transaction; for a chunk it must equal the already accepted admission named by the chunk.

release_attestation_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the exact release attestation for a chunk; JSON null for a manifest, which never releases secret material.

receipt_digest.description: SHA-256(UTF8('ak.history-response-send-receipt-v1') || 0x00 || JCS(the closed receipt with receipt_digest and service_proof omitted)).

service_proof.description: First release-service proof over the closed receipt including receipt_digest and excluding service_proof. Exact duplicate returns these identical originally accepted bytes; transport never emits a separately signed duplicate variant.

history_key_response_send_receipt.description: Small immutable source-facing success receipt. It never echoes the recipient response record, release authority locators, source record, request receipt or ciphertext.

holder_trusted_basis.description: Holder-pinned canonical accepted Seal basis with exactly one confirmed head per Realm from the accepted register/rotate tuple. Cursor and every returned archive bind it byte-for-byte.

organization_recovery_archive_list_query.description: Recipient-bound RHRK archive read/list query. The authenticated holder_service_id is transport authority and is not caller-supplied here. from_epoch/to_epoch, when present, form one inclusive non-empty range. The service returns only rows whose exact historical key tuple names this recovery_key_id/key_agreement_ref and accepted key provenance Event, whose holder_trusted_basis matches byte-for-byte, whose holder_service_id matches the authenticated service, and whose current holder_signing_ref resolves to the exact method_controller_principal_id. Replay from holder_trusted_basis proves that accepted_key_evidence_ref is reducer-effective; no singular activation Seal selector exists. Cursor binds the authenticated holder_service_id, current method_controller_principal_id, exact query selectors and last ordering tuple. byte_limit below the registry minimum legal item size returns limit_exceeded rather than a zero-progress page.

archive_sequence.description: Strictly monotonic sequence assigned by holder_service_id on first durable acceptance of this immutable archive replica.

archive_replica_digest.description: Exact canonical digest of the holder's first durably accepted organization_recovery_archive_replica. The holder MUST copy this value into SelfHistoryTraversalAccess.archive_replica_digest; archive_digest, traversal_intent_digest and container_event_ref are not substitutes.

organization_recovery_archive_list_item.description: A content-addressed row. archive_replica_digest is the exact holder-accepted replica identity and the only access coordinate for the self traversal surfaces. history_traversal_retention uses organization_recovery_archive/archive_lifetime, starts from this tuple's holder_trusted_basis, has requested_ranges exactly [{from_epoch:archive.epoch,to_epoch:archive.epoch}], and replays to a target basis that proves both the accepted key tuple and this one winning archive transition. container_event_ref equals the winning transition Event. No proof page, package root or singular activation Seal is carried.

organization_recovery_archive_list_outco.description: Canonical-byte-paged recipient-bound projection. Rows are ordered by (archive_sequence numeric ascending, container_event_ref UTF-8 bytes); a delayed old epoch receives a new sequence and cannot be inserted behind a cursor. Cursor binds the authenticated holder_service_id, current method_controller_principal_id, exact query digest including accepted evidence Event and complete holder_trusted_basis, and the last ordering tuple. The direct Seal traversal closure has the same long-term retention/replication lifetime as its archive. The high-privilege holder service may resolve every Control Move, Seal and registered apply_seal dependency required by that closure, including membership/policy/control metadata, but no unrelated ordinary Event, generic timeline scan, membership grant or send authority. Unknown scope, absent rows, wrong holder service or method-controller authority and unauthorized or mismatched tuple all produce the same not_found response shape.

organization_recovery_archive_replica.description: Private immutable S2S archive replica to the exact holder_service_id frozen by the archive tuple. It binds one container Event, the accepted-key evidence Event, the distinct holder trusted basis and one archive-lifetime exact-one-epoch direct Seal traversal. Semantic uniqueness is (effective_scope,mls_group_id,epoch,container_event_ref,archive tuple digest). The full body digest is only the exact-retry key: changing replicated_at cannot allocate another sequence for the same semantic row. Archive bytes and the traversal's complete registered apply_seal dependency closure are retained and reconciled for the archive lifetime; v1 has no remote GC or renewal state.

archive_sequence.description: First durable holder acceptance assigns this monotonic sequence; duplicate retry returns the identical value.

membership_authority_request_body.description: One exact current Realm/Circle membership at the requested current confirmed basis with exactly one head per Realm. Account Station query, not a history proof. Canonical body at most 64 KiB.

membership_authority_outcome.description: Complete current membership result for one exact selector. The caller is currently allowed to see membership in this scope. No history, signature closure or continuation. Canonical response at most 64 KiB.

history_authority_request_body.description: Exact current history authorization for one scope and ActorId. Canonical request at most 64 KiB; no history proof or pagination.

history_authority_outcome.description: Current accepted membership, MLS join epoch and scope policy floor. No client bootstrap checkpoint. No grant for later key release. Canonical complete response at most 64 KiB.

history_source_signer_result.description: One exact historical public signer result from the requester Account Station. The evidence ref is the only dictionary key. This result is not a portable proof or a grant for another record.

source_signer_evidence_ref.description: Content-addressed source signer evidence. Its embedded digest is the sole wire copy (encoding.md 4.0.1) and resolves through the request-receipt governance-dependency surface to the exact historical source signer and verification method.

public_key_b64u.description: Canonical unpadded base64url of exactly 32 Ed25519 public-key bytes.

source_signer_evidence_ref.description: Content-addressed source signer evidence. Its embedded digest is the sole wire copy (encoding.md 4.0.1) and resolves through the request-receipt governance-dependency surface to the exact historical source signer and verification method.

identity_link_public_key_b64u.description: Canonical unpadded base64url of exactly 32 Ed25519 public-key bytes.
